title: WiN — Wiedererzählen im Norden. Digitale Analyse weltlicher Erzählungen in niederdeutschen Inkunabeln (WiN-Korpus v1.0)
notes: The WiN project (Goettingen GCDH, funded by Niedersächsisches Vorab) built a parallel corpus of Early New High German short narratives and their Middle Low German versions from late 15th c. incunabula (Dracole, Griseldis, Juden, Graf, Kaufleute...), published as WiN-Korpus v1.0 (2022) in the LAUDATIO repository (HU Berlin), TEI-annotated, with the transcription handbook on DARIAH-DE; the project page is uni-goettingen.de/de/wiedererzählen+im+norden./607371.html. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: Georg-August-Universität Göttingen (Heike Sahm, Marco Coniglio, Chiara De Bastiani, Anabel Recker, Jan Christian Schaffert; PRO*Niedersachsen)
license_note: The LAUDATIO repository metadata for the corpus (id XnU19IIBa2XDdNuCXFx-, version 1.0, published 2022 by the University of Göttingen) gives corpus_publication_license https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. This is the corpus-level licence; the underlying incunabula are public domain, and the browse page itself is rendered by script, so the URL is the API record that states it.
